title: Consent banner theme v2
description: The `theme` of a consent configuration (PUT /sites/{siteId}/consent/draft). Every field is optional on write: missing fields take the defaults shown here, and the stored theme is complete. The server compiles it (with the custom CSS) into the banner stylesheet sent as `consent.css` in window.__an_cfg. v1 themes (bg, fg, ac, acf, rad, pos) are still accepted and are upgraded on read; the two shapes cannot be mixed. See docs/integration/consent-banner.md.

colors.description: One button style for both Accept and Reject: there is deliberately no secondary button colour (Garante 2021, B2). Contrast of at least 4.5:1 is required for text/background, accentText/accent, link/background.

accent.description: Background and border of Accept and Reject; focus ring.

backdrop.description: Page tint around a `center` banner (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa). Painted only: the page stays usable (no blocking overlay).

family.description: `inherit` (the page's font), `system` (a system-font stack) or a comma-separated list of family names: letters, digits, spaces, - and _, optionally quoted. Fonts are never downloaded.

size.description: px; null inherits the page's font size.

buttonRadius.description: Accept, Reject and reopen button corners, px (999 = pill).

breakpoint.description: Viewports this wide or narrower (px) use the mobile layout.

maxWidth.description: px; the banner never exceeds the viewport minus two offsets.

offset.description: Distance from the viewport edges, px.

mobile.description: Every mobile position spans the viewport with equal side gaps (sheet: none) and respects the safe-area insets.

reopen.description: Floating button that reopens the preferences after a choice (when show_floating_reopen is on). It always has an aria-label with the `reopen` text, so the icon-only variant stays accessible.

text.description: null: colors.accentText. Contrast with the background of at least 4.5:1.

css.description: Custom CSS (at most 8192 bytes) written with the public class names .banner .title .body .link .actions .button .close .reopen .reopen-icon, with :hover, :focus-visible, :active and @media blocks. Selectors and properties are checked against allowlists; errors come back as 422 under theme.css with line and column. See docs/integration/consent-banner.md.

buttons.description: Accept and Reject side by side, or one above the other.

offset.description: Distance from the viewport corner, px.
